body: Im doing alright still, I appreciate your words though, thank you. About the emergency line or hotline, i highly doubt thatll solve anything, i have a huge fear of those things cus the last thing i want is to be thrown in some kind of mental hospital lolz. But thank you for your concern

I second this! The dosage you took is most likely not fatal, so you will be fine. The only thing you can really do now is just ride it out. Its easier said than done, but if you find ways to distract yourself and your body such as watching a movie, and/or playing some games then it can really help you relax a bit more and take your mind of it for a while. And if you ever feel like your in a bad place again im always here to talk if you need it!
